provenance.note: machine audit: worker, gate, reviewer; not confirmed by a human

verdicts.summary: Lean has a stronger form of it. Both halves of (10.2) are present, and one of them is pinned to a concrete constant. (i) `div u = 0`: Lean's `CandidateProperties.divergence_free` asserts `spatialDivergence u t x = 0` for every `t ∈ Ico 0 1` and every `x`, i.e. on exactly the paper's domain ℝ³ × [0,1); `spatialDivergence u t x = ∑ i : Fin 3, (spatialDerivative u t x (coordinateVector i)) i` (NavierStokes/ProblemStatement.lean:67-68) is the ordinary Cartesian divergence, so this matches term for term. (ii) `u(·,t) = p(·,t) = 0 for all sufficiently small t ≥ 0`: the paper asserts ∃ε>0 ∀t∈[0,ε); Lean asserts the explicit `∀ t : ℝ, |t| ≤ 3 / 8 → ∀ x, u (t,x) = 0 ∧ p (t,x) = 0`. That is stronger in two ways — it names the threshold ε = 3/8 instead of existentially quantifying it, and it also covers t < 0 (vacuous for the paper, whose fields live on [0,1)). The paper's clause follows by taking ε = 3/8 and discarding the negative times. The vanishing is not an extra hypothesis but a proved consequence of the time switch: `timeSwitch_zero_of_abs_le` (NavierStokes/SmoothCutoffs.lean:256) gives `timeSwitch t = 0` for |t| ≤ 3/8, and the candidate velocity/pressure are `TimeLocalization.activatedVelocity`/`activatedPressure` of the cut fields (NavierStokes/R3CompactCandidate.lean:201-205). Nothing in (10.2) is weakened. Noted for the record: `local_theorem_with_compact_candidate` is the Prop-10.1-aligned packaging (it conjoins the candidate properties, the localization agreement near the origin for t ∈ [3/4,1), and the early rest clause in one theorem), while `selected_candidate_one_with_initial_rest` states the same conjunction `CandidateProperties ∧ early rest` on its own.
